tasks.title: Yield / conversion
tasks.metrics: MAE/RMSE in percentage points; Spearman rank
tasks.qualification: Keep analytical yield, isolated yield and conversion separate.
tasks.implementation_note: Consult catalog.table.task_fields for an implemented, target-isolated adapter. A contract alone is not a completed model benchmark.

tasks.title: Reaction success
tasks.target: Observed success at a declared assay threshold
tasks.recommended_split: Substrate and source holdouts; retain failed attempts
tasks.qualification: A thresholded measured yield is an operational label. Missing data and sampled decoys are not failed experiments.
tasks.implementation_note: Consult catalog.table.task_fields for an implemented, target-isolated adapter. A contract alone is not a completed model benchmark.

tasks.title: Recorded-condition recovery
tasks.target: Solvent/reagent/catalyst set, and conditions where available
tasks.metrics: Top-k set recall; component F1; valid condition sets
tasks.qualification: Extends existing SynRXN reagent/catalyst inference. A reported recipe is one acceptable answer, not a complete success set.
tasks.implementation_note: Consult catalog.table.task_fields for an implemented, target-isolated adapter. A contract alone is not a completed model benchmark.

tasks.title: Measured condition ranking
tasks.inputs: Fixed substrate pair and measured candidate conditions
tasks.target: Ranked catalyst/condition choices by observed response
tasks.metrics: NDCG; Spearman rank; top-k yield regret
tasks.qualification: Use measured comparable panels. Recorded-condition recovery alone cannot establish which condition is best.
tasks.implementation_note: Consult catalog.table.task_fields for an implemented, target-isolated adapter. A contract alone is not a completed model benchmark.

tasks.title: Regioselectivity
tasks.target: Reactive atom/site or ranked product sites
tasks.metrics: Top-k site accuracy; symmetry-aware atom equivalence
tasks.qualification: Product annotations do not establish complete product ratios or selectivity magnitudes.
tasks.implementation_note: Consult catalog.table.task_fields for an implemented, target-isolated adapter. A contract alone is not a completed model benchmark.

tasks.title: Enantioselectivity
tasks.metrics: MAE in native units; sign/dominant-enantiomer accuracy
tasks.qualification: Preserve signed/absolute ee, temperature and target definition. ΔΔG‡ derived from ratios is not a directly measured barrier.
tasks.implementation_note: Consult catalog.table.task_fields for an implemented, target-isolated adapter. A contract alone is not a completed model benchmark.

tasks.title: Sequential optimization
tasks.inputs: History of attempted conditions and responses
tasks.recommended_split: Hold out complete campaigns or substrate pairs
tasks.metrics: Best response versus experiment budget; regret; hit count
tasks.qualification: Use only observed candidate points for tabular replay. Label surrogate-based simulations separately.
tasks.implementation_note: Consult catalog.table.task_fields for an implemented, target-isolated adapter. A contract alone is not a completed model benchmark.

tasks.title: Condition-dependent product distribution
tasks.inputs: Substrate, solvent composition, temperature and residence time
tasks.target: Starting-material and product yields under each condition
tasks.recommended_split: Group complete campaigns; hold out solvent mixtures or condition regions
tasks.metrics: Per-product MAE; composition error; selectivity ranking
tasks.qualification: These are condition-dependent outcomes, not physical trajectories or direct rate constants.
tasks.implementation_note: Consult catalog.table.task_fields for an implemented, target-isolated adapter. A contract alone is not a completed model benchmark.

tasks.title: Solvent effects
tasks.recommended_split: Group all solvents/methods for each reaction
tasks.metrics: MAE/RMSE by energy type; per-reaction solvent ranking
tasks.qualification: Relative solvent corrections and absolute free-energy barriers are different endpoints.
tasks.implementation_note: Consult catalog.table.task_fields for an implemented, target-isolated adapter. A contract alone is not a completed model benchmark.

tasks.title: Rate constants / rate laws
tasks.inputs: Reaction, catalyst where relevant, temperature and pressure
tasks.target: log rate, Arrhenius parameters or enzyme kcat
tasks.recommended_split: Reaction family; enzyme homology; source laboratory
tasks.metrics: Log-space MAE/RMSE; rate-curve error over valid range
tasks.qualification: Preserve units, valid T/p ranges, assay aggregation and measured/computed/estimated provenance.

tasks.title: Transition-state geometry
tasks.target: TS coordinates and verified saddle-point structure
tasks.metrics: Aligned geometry error; connectivity; TS validation success
tasks.qualification: Geometry RMSD alone is not proof of a first-order saddle point connecting the specified endpoints.

tasks.metrics: Energy MAE; force MAE; pathway/barrier consistency
